title: Inspire expression / Pride Here

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Let a cultural message vary the visual voice so people can recognize their own interests within the brand.
strategic_value: Expressive type, stickers and photography can connect Instagram to the Pride moment shown.
demonstration: An offset portrait sits on purple with tilted orange Pride Here lettering, a rainbow heart and the line To be here is defiance.
practical_value: Use a cultural message to justify more expressive type and color while keeping the photograph central.

content_islands.name: Purple field and portrait
content_islands.spec: Offset the photograph to expose a broad purple strip at left and above.

content_islands.name: Pride headline and sticker
content_islands.spec: Angle orange lettering over the photo edge and place the rainbow heart near the upper right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Inspire expression principle identifies creative interests and self-expression as the aim.
reference_purposes.Expression: Tilted type, a rainbow heart and purple field show a deliberately expressive composition.
reference_purposes.Application: The example applies the identity to Pride communication.
